What made this attack noteworthy wasn't its scale, but how easily the hackers gained access — by simply using the manufacturer's default password "1111." input type='checkbox' name='article227' value='https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/photos-show-turkeys-youngest-oil-wrestlers-keeping-14th-123558690' / 227 - a href='https://www.google.com/search?q=abcnews.go.com+Turkey%27s+youngest+oil+wrestlers+keeping+a+14th-century+tradition+aliveOn+a+grass+field+slick+with+olive+oil+and+steeped+in+tradition%2C+hundreds+of+boys+as+young+as+11+joined+the+ranks+of+Turkey%E2%80%99s+most+time-honored+sporting+event%3A+the+annual+Kirkpinar+Oil+Wrestling+Championship.%0A%0AHeld+every+summer+in+the+northwestern+city+of+Edirne%2C+the+event+is+said+to+date+back+to+the+14th+century+as+a+way+of+keeping+the+Ottoman+Empire%E2%80%99s+fighting+men+fit+and+ready+for+battle.%0A%0AThe+sport%2C+which+is+on+UNESCO%E2%80%99s+intangible+cultural+heritage+list%2C+sees+wrestlers+cover+themselves+in+olive+oil+and+try+to+press+their+opponent%E2%80%99s+back+to+the+ground+to+win+the+bout.%0A%0AAlongside+the+men+contesting%2C+youngsters+also+don+the+iconic+%E2%80%9Ckispet%E2%80%9D+leather+trousers+to+embark+on+a+slippery+test+of+strength%2C+skill+and+stamina+under+the+scorching+sun.%0A%0AThe+boys+are+ranked+in+divisions+based+on+age%2C+height+and+build%2C+with+the+youngest+generally+placed+in+the+%E2%80%9Cminik%2C%E2%80%9D+or+tiny%2C+category.+Under+strict+safety+regulations%2C+their+matches+are+shorter+and+closely+supervised.%0A%0AMost+young+wrestlers+train...July+08%2C+2025' target='blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'Search - /a a href='https://12ft.io/https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/photos-show-turkeys-youngest-oil-wrestlers-keeping-14th-123558690' target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'Turkey's youngest oil wrestlers keeping a 14th-century tradition aliveOn a grass field slick with olive oil and steeped in tradition, hundreds of boys as young as 11 joined the ranks of Turkey’s most time-honored sporting event: the annual Kirkpinar Oil Wrestling Championship.

Held every summer in the northwestern city of Edirne, the event is said to date back to the 14th century as a way of keeping the Ottoman Empire’s fighting men fit and ready for battle.

The sport, which is on UNESCO’s intangible cultural heritage list, sees wrestlers cover themselves in olive oil and try to press their opponent’s back to the ground to win the bout.

Alongside the men contesting, youngsters also don the iconic “kispet” leather trousers to embark on a slippery test of strength, skill and stamina under the scorching sun.

The boys are ranked in divisions based on age, height and build, with the youngest generally placed in the “minik,” or tiny, category. Under strict safety regulations, their matches are shorter and closely supervised.
